articles.summary: ISSAQUAH, Wash., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Costco Wholesale Corporation (“Costco” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: COST) today reported net sales of $24.50 billion for the retail month of October, the four weeks ended November 1, 2026, an increase of 12.6 percent from $21.75 billion last year. Net sales for the first nine weeks were $54.52 billion, an increase of 12.8 percent from $48.33 billion last year. Comparable sales were as follows: 4 Weeks 9 Weeks U.S. 12.6% 12.5% Canada 4.9% 5.7% Other International 9.4% 10.2% Total Company 11.1% 11.3% Comparable sales excluding the impacts from changes in gasoline prices and foreign exchange were as follows: 4 Weeks 9 Weeks U.S. 8.1% 8.1% Canada 3.5% 4.3% Other International 6.9% 7.4% Total Company 7.3% 7.5% Digitally-enabled sales, which are sales initiated through a digital device, whether fulfilled through a warehouse,
articles.title: Costco Wholesale Corporation Reports October Sales Results
